purpose: Report an outcome that confirms an earlier expectation.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
give explain a reason cause result
express feelings speak politely show respect
I forgot my umbrella and, sure enough, it rained.
As expected, the parking lot was full on the holiday.
I wrote in a hurry and, predictably, there were typos.
restrictions: Common with an unwelcome but predictable result.
mistake: Use for a confirmed result, rather than a future guess.
